dimensions.assessment: Applies directly and exclusively to current Members of Congress serving in the Senate and House of Representatives.
dimensions.evidence: the term "Member of Congress" means an individual serving in a position under subparagraph (A), (B), or (C) of section 601(a)(1) of the Legislative Reorganization Act of 1946

dimensions.assessment: Reduces salary compensation day-for-day or places salary in escrow during a lapse in appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: exclude from the payments otherwise required to be made with respect to that pay period for the compensation of each Member of Congress... an amount equal to the product of... one day's worth of pay

dimensions.assessment: Results in minor temporary savings or escrow withholding of member salaries during a government shutdown, but specifies no broad federal fiscal totals.
Amends internal administrative payroll procedures for the House and Senate during government shutdowns.
dimensions.evidence: the payroll administrator of each House of Congress shall exclude from the payments otherwise required to be made... an amount equal to... one day's worth of pay

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent payroll rules that take effect following the November 2026 federal election, with interim escrow rules.
dimensions.evidence: This subsection shall apply with respect to days occurring after the date of the regularly scheduled general election for Federal office held in November 2026

importance_detail.rationale: Reduces or holds in escrow the annual pay of Members of Congress during periods of federal government shutdowns.
